THE PREMISE
"SHE'S A TERRORIST AND I LOVE HER" is a dark comedy about a down-and-out man (Haresh Tilani) who enters a sham marriage for a quick payout, only to find that his 'wife' (Alexis Sueann) is an extremist hell-bent on blowing herself up in a terror attack on Singapore. With true love as his only weapon, it’s a battle to win the heart and mind of his wife to stop the terror attack and save the country.
